elevate.move: Turn the plates into a real art-directed plate series: approved stock under one sand-and-ink duotone, or detailed engravings with true pool detail (tile line, pebble, skimmer, coping), each with folio and month, sequenced problem to result across the year, with one plate revealed by a scroll-tied clip tied to its month tab.

One nameable idea, 'the year turns as you read': on each spread entry the rail tab slides out, the folio numeral rolls from the previous month to this one and the 12-cell month bar fills to the same cell on one 500ms ease-out; everything else stays static except tool readouts.
